synth.notes:
Model: axis block-row a, pieces as 3x3-block sets, target block sets, selection read from 0-filled hole centres (axis centres off pieces first).
A1/A2 move the selected axis or piece one block; A3/A4 move only pieces; pieces are blocked by bounds and other pieces; the axis is never blocked and passes UNDER pieces (the step-71 mechanic).
Reflections = piece blocks mirrored to 2a-r, clipped to the board, skipped on piece-occupied blocks; the mixed reflection outcome is just re-extraction (merging/splitting/re-ranking of 4-conn comps), not an object field.
Render wall1<target2<reflection3<piece4 (first solid top-down, else fill of the topmost hole), then re-extract; wall/player comps over own cells plus all 0 cells, 0-only comps ranked but dropped.
Passes 30/30 stateless as well; unconfirmed: A5 cycle order beyond axis->first piece, A6/A7 (treated as no-ops).
